note: Both sets extract the same four claims from Figure 7-3 and the surrounding text, with identical values, conditions and quotes. In both, the 6.302336º value is duplicated across two claims and mislabeled as generic θ rather than θK (the blade-pitch angle at which pitch sensitivity doubles), and both truncate the unit to 'watt/ra' in the first claim. Set B's fourth claim binds the property slightly more precisely (pitch sensitivity (∂P/∂θ) at θ = 0º) than A's, but this is a trivial wording difference and both are supported.
